root_text: WHO reports on hMPV in North America.  Infection rates are rising, but mostly mild.  Just like other winter viruses, hMPV typically causes cold-like symptoms & resolves quickly. #hMPV #RespiratoryVirus #NorthAmerica #HealthNews #WinterV
